description_html:
About the role

Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for data centres and large industrials. We're looking for a Project Electrical Engineer to be the electrical owner on first-of-a-kind power projects - private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, MV and HV grid connections.

This is a technical role with a unique expanded scope to broader infrastructure project management. Early on you are the project manager: you hold the programme, the development budget and the external parties, from concept design through connection offer to design freeze and financial close. From there you stay on as the electrical owner through construction, commissioning and energisation, with a delivery team around you.


What you'll do

  • Own the programme and the development budget. Schedule from early concept to design freeze - siting, connection application, planning, consents, procurement, long-lead items - worked back from the customer's energisation date. Appoint and manage consultants, ICPs and study providers. Surface risk early and clearly communicate them to the stakeholders.

  • Own the electrical concept through to sign-off. Single-line diagrams, general arrangements, switchgear and plant layouts, cable routes, metering and comms architecture. Direct and interrogate the studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, earthing, power quality). Chair design reviews and stage gates, and take options to the Project Lead and customer with a recommendation.

  • Lead the grid interface. DNO, TO and NESO - applications and offers, technical requirements, securities and milestones, contestable and non-contestable scope, ICP/IDNO coordination, MPAN registration.

  • Budget ownership through completion. Credible capex inputs for the project model across plant, substation, civils and enabling works, with value engineering and optioneering. Then FAT/SAT witnessing, commissioning plans and sequences of operation, energisation and handover.

  • Take on what you haven't done before. First-of-a-kind means no precedent, no standard design and no colleague who's done it. Get to a working understanding of an unfamiliar technology or scope fast, and deliver it.


    • What you'll have

  • Master’s degree , or equivalent, in electrical or power systems engineering. CEng welcome, not essential.

  • 5+ years delivering energy or infrastructure projects, with a strong grounding in MV and HV systems.

  • Real infrastructure experience - substations, networks, industrial plant, data centres, utilities, water or transport. We care that you've dealt with ground conditions, easements, consents, tie-ins to live assets and construction sequencing. This is not a grid-only role.

  • You've personally held a programme and a budget on a development or pre-construction project.

  • A GB/European grid connection taken from connection offer to grid code compliance and energisation, with working knowledge of the Grid Code, CUSC, SQSS, G99/G100, ENA engineering recommendations and BS 7671.

  • Able to coordinate a multi-discipline design where you're not the expert in every discipline - and to spot a weak answer from a civil or mechanical engineer.

  • Comfortable as the single point of accountability with an incomplete picture, holding external parties accountable without formal authority.

  • Full UK driving licence and willing to travel to site.

    •  
    It would be great if you have...
     
    BESS, private wire, microgrid or behind-the-meter generation; data centre or mission-critical power (MV/LV distribution, UPS, generators, redundancy topologies, commissioning levels); study tools (ETAP, PowerFactory, IPSA, PSS/E, PSCAD) or Python; IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, SCADA and metering data flows; NEC or FIDIC contract and change management. Project management credentials (APM, PRINCE2, MS Project, Primavera) - though we care far more about what you've delivered.

description_html:
Octopus is a rapidly growing, global energy business. We are looking for a grid analyst with a passion for understanding and designing electricity grids. This role is an exciting opportunity to use and develop superb tools to help inform our own commercial decisions as well as to help shape the energy system for participants, both in the UK and around the world. 

In the 10 years since launching we have become the largest household supplier in the UK, one of the fastest growing in Europe and are scaling businesses in everything from Renewable Generation to domestic flexibility, and from domestic heat pumps to public EV charging. In total we are operating dozens of businesses in over 30 countries around the World - and we have a lot further to go.


What you'll do

  • Grid assessment: Map, analyze and model grids across various markets. Analyze and provide insights to inform capex strategy, prioritising non-wire solutions.

  • Techno-economic and electrical power flow modeling to define optimal mix of resources against specific objectives (grid constraints, peak profile, LOLE, LCOE etc.)

  • Technical assessment of solutions for grid quality and stability issues, with a focus on non-wire solutions (flexibility and BESS). 

  • Grid development plans: support the team in reviewing and designing grid investment plans or Integrated Resource Plans, for technical sign-off. 

  • Interconnection: Analyse grid constraints and provide insights on grid connection queues.

  • Knowledge of linear, economic modelling, e.g. plexos, is a plus. 

  • Experience with DERs, medium and high voltage grids and utility-scale energy projects.

  • Deep understanding of energy economics and grid infrastructure principles, enjoys generating insights from large and complex sets of energy data and metrics.

At Octopus Energy Trading, we’re on a mission to reshape the future of energy. As part of Octopus Energy Group, we’re creating an innovative approach to trading that will accelerate the transition to a Net Zero world. With the growth of renewables and a push toward decarbonising heating and transport, greater flexibility in the grid is essential. We are building cutting-edge technology to optimise everything from domestic EV charging to grid-scale batteries, to meet the global demand for energy flexibility.

We’re looking for passionate and unconventional thinkers to join us on this journey, bringing a diversity of experience and ideas to shape a more efficient, flexible, and sustainable energy system.

With an increase in variable and distributed supply, using data for trading and forecasting has never been more important. Octopus has always had a tech-first approach, and our trading and analytics tools are all built in-house. We are looking for a data scientist who’s comfortable building data pipelines bringing together internal and external data to create market leading insights using both classical and ML techniques. This will include looking at demand, renewables and transmission system fundamentals forecasts focussed to begin with on the GB intraday power market.


What You'll Do

  • Exploring the types of data needed to effectively trade the GB intraday power market

  • Building, improving and maintaining models to forecast electricity demand and renewable generation, primarily in GB but developing into all of Western Europe;

  • Finding high quality, novel data sources to base our forecasts off of;

  • Development on forecasting framework and tools;

  • Maintaining and automating forecasting processes, whilst building in checks and alerting;

  • Utilising these forecasting models to build or enhance our price forecasts

  • Collaborating with Trading, Renewables, Flexibility and other teams to utilise our combined knowledge and data.


    • What You'll Need

  • Experience with Python is essential;

  • A good understanding of what forecasting techniques to use and the ability to build a simple baseline and quickly iterate;

  • Ability to communicate your approach, including its strengths and limitations;

  • Able to quickly understand commercial and industry concepts;

  • Team player excited at the idea of ownership across lots of different projects and tools;

title: Commercial Analyst (Data Centres and Industrials)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Octopus Energy Group
description_html:
About the role

Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for datacenters and large industrials. The deals are first-of-a-kind: private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, flexible load, novel grid connections.

This is a quantitative role with direct exposure to large-scale innovative power projects. You'll own the project model, build pricing strategies and directly participate to final investment decisions.


What you'll do

  • Own the project model for each opportunity - generation, BESS, flexible load, network cost; capex, opex, revenue stack, IRR, downside cases. Build project-specific models while developing toolings and standard assumptions to support our growing pipeline

  • Price the offer. Turn a customer's load profile and reliability requirement into a deliverable price and structure - tariff, PPA, tolling, availability-based - and show which one allocates risk sensibly for both sides.

  • Value the flex. Model storage and flexible load across wholesale, Balancing Mechanism, ancillary services and Capacity Market. Quantify network charges (TNUoS, DUoS, BSUoS), curtailment and connection options.

  • Develop the business case. Build internal and external presentations to support from indicative customer proposals to project final investment decisions.

  • Track the portfolio and read the market. Monitor live projects against approved cases - spend, milestones, connection dates - and identify early and quantify regulatory change (connections reform, REMA, network charging). Support term sheets and diligence from indicative to signed.


    • What you'll need

  • 3–5 years in a numerate commercial role - infrastructure or renewables development, project finance, banking, energy trading or origination, strategy or energy consultancy.

  • Financial modelling from first principles: DCF, IRR, scenarios and sensitivities. You can build a model someone else can follow and eventually develop it as a standard tool for other team members to use.

  • Advanced knowledge of GB/European power markets, and how network and connection costs land on a project.

  • Advanced Excel and Python

  • Able to take a messy, incomplete problem to a clear recommendation

  • Quantitative degree - economics, engineering, finance, maths, physics - or equivalent experience.

    •

    Datacenters, large industrial load or behind-the-meter/private wire projects; BESS revenue stacking; a PPA, tolling or connection agreement taken to signature; Aurora, PLEXOS or equivalent.

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Zipwater
description_html:
Zip Water is an industry leading filtered boiling, chilled and sparkling water specialist, known globally for being home to the world’s most advanced range of drinking water solutions. We provide businesses and homes in more than 70 countries with an extensive range of high-quality drinking and hot water solutions, designed to transform the way individuals, organisations and businesses provide water, for good.

We are pleased to announce this exciting opportunity to join our Supply Chain team as a Claims & Returns Coordinator. This role is responsible for the end-to-end management, administration and continuous improvement of customer returns, carrier collections and transport claims processes. The role acts as the central coordination point between Customer Service, Logistics, Warehouse, Finance, Sales and external carriers to ensure returned goods, collection activities, customer credits and claims recoveries are managed efficiently and professionally.

The position will also drive return reduction initiatives, identify root causes, improve customer experience, maximize recovery of costs from carriers and customers, and provide KPI reporting and governance across the returns and claim function. This is an office-based role to be close to the warehouse returns and logistic teams.

Core Role & Responsibilities:

• Manage the complete Return Authorization (RAN) process from request through to closure.

• Coordinate customer returns and carrier collections.

• Manage transport damage, shortage, loss and non-delivery claims.

• Gather evidence and submit claims within carrier deadlines.

• Track claim progress and maximize recoveries.

• Maintain ERP/WMS return records.

• Produce KPI reports and trend analysis.

• Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.

• Support customer credits and recharge processes.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • Experience in logistics, returns, claims or customer service administration.
  • Strong Excel, ERP/WMS, communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Great attention to detail & organisation skills
  • Customer focused to ensure great service is delivered
  • Commercially aware
  • Ability to take a proactive approach to assigned workload

Benefits

  • 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
  • Company Sick Pay (after qualifying period)
  • Full training and continuous support with your team
  • Modern canteen and break “chill out” areas
  • There’s onsite parking – we have plenty of space!!
  • Cycle to Work scheme available
  • A market leading company pension

  • Option to join Health Care Cash Plan

description_html:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Video Creator & Editor based in United Kingdom.

This role combines AI video generation and hands-on editing to create high-performing direct-response advertising for Meta and TikTok.
You will own creatives end to end, from interpreting briefs and generating AI footage to editing polished, launch-ready ads.
The position focuses on UGC-style talking-head content, product scenes, b-roll, hooks, variations, and conversion-driven storytelling.
You will work closely with Creative Strategists and the Paid Social team to turn concepts and performance insights into compelling new assets.
Success means consistently delivering high-quality, on-brief creatives at volume while keeping revisions low and continuously improving what performs.
You will join a growing remote video team and have access to AI tools, established workflows, and real campaign environments in which to develop your skills.
The role is fully remote, full-time, and follows UK working hours.


Accountabilities
  • Generate AI video assets for Meta and TikTok advertising, including UGC-style talking-head clips, product scenes, b-roll, and complete concept videos.
  • Develop and refine prompts, reference images, and generation settings while maintaining a reusable library of effective prompts and workflows.
  • Edit high-volume direct-response ads by combining AI-generated footage with scripts, raw footage, UGC, and approved product assets.
  • Create compelling first-second hooks, rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, product demonstrations, offers, and clear calls to action.
  • Produce multiple variations of successful concepts by testing different hooks, scenes, characters, openings, pacing, and visual treatments.
  • Maintain visual consistency across characters, products, and brand assets while quality-checking generated content for realistic motion, readable text, accurate product representation, and other AI-generation issues.
  • Add motion graphics using After Effects or an equivalent tool and ensure creatives meet platform and brand requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Strategists to execute briefs accurately, respond quickly to feedback, and contribute new angles, hooks, and formats suited to AI generation.
  • Keep project files, assets, and feedback organized using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar collaboration and asset-management tools.
  • Stay current with evolving AI video models and creative technologies, testing new tools and incorporating effective workflows into production.
  • Maintain reliable turnaround times and a high-quality output while contributing to creative testing, learning, and scalable advertising concepts.

    • Requirements:

    • Bring 1–3 years of experience in creative or video production, including e-commerce or direct-response paid-social editing, with a portfolio demonstrating both self-edited conversion-focused ads and AI-generated video work.
    • Have hands-on experience with AI video-generation tools such as Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Sora, Runway, or similar platforms, with strong prompting and iteration skills.
    • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut, together with After Effects or equivalent motion-graphics capabilities.
    • Be comfortable using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar tools for organized asset management, collaboration, and feedback.
    • Understand hook-first, direct-response editing for Meta and TikTok, including rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, visual proof, product demonstrations, offers, CTAs, and testable creative variations.
    • Have a strong visual eye and the ability to distinguish AI-generated footage that feels authentic from content that appears artificial or unrealistic.
    • Be able to maintain high output without sacrificing quality, respond quickly to feedback, and work accurately under pressure.
    • Demonstrate creativity, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and a thoughtful, methodical approach to production.
    • Have strong written and spoken English, proactive communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a remote creative team.
    • Be available for a full-time, exclusive commitment without other clients or freelance work alongside the role.
    • Experience with AI image-generation tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, or Flux, AI voice tools such as ElevenLabs, winning or scaled advertising campaigns, visually driven DTC categories, motion design, compositing, 3D, VFX, or sound design is considered a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation discussed individually based on experience and location.
      • Fully remote, full-time work following UK working hours.
      • Access to AI video-generation tools and approved creative workflows.
      • Opportunities to develop AI generation and video-editing skills through real advertising campaigns.
      • Regular structured meetings and scheduled feedback sessions with the creative team.
      • The opportunity to join a new ten-person video team operating in a high-volume creative testing environment.
      • Room for professional growth as AI models, creative workflows, and production capabilities continue to evolve.

title: Facilities/Maintenance Technician
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Cirrus
description_html:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

The Facilities Technician is a hands-on role responsible for the day-to-day operation, upkeep, and presentation of the Edinburgh site. This position provides first-line response to facilities issues, supports preventive and reactive maintenance, assists with moves and minor works, and works closely with contractors and internal stakeholders to keep the building running safely and efficiently. This is a practical role suited to someone who enjoys variety, problem-solving, and being visible on site.


Key Responsibilities:

Facilities and Building Support

  • Carry out first-line reactive maintenance tasks across the site, including basic repairs, fixture and fitting adjustments, and minor building works.
  • Perform routine checks and planned preventive maintenance tasks as assigned.
  • Identify, report, and help resolve building, office, and lab-related issues to minimise disruption.

    • Contractor and Works Support

    • Support and escort contractors on site, ensuring work areas are safe, tidy, and compliant.
    • Help monitor contractor work and escalate issues to the Facilities Manager or Facilities Engineer as required.
    • Assist with small projects, minor refurbishments, and facilities upgrades.

      • Office, Lab, and Support Services

      • Support desk moves, furniture moves, and basic workspace changes.
      • Assist with lab and equipment installations where required, limited to non-specialist tasks.
      • Support site services such as meeting room setup, events, deliveries, and general building logistics.
      • The role is expected to be approximately 95% facilities support and 5% involves holiday and absence cover for the shipping and receiving delivery room, including parcel handling and national shipments. This cover element is not a specialist requirement of the role, and brief internal training will be provided.

        • Health, Safety, and Compliance

        • Support site health and safety requirements, safe systems of work, and housekeeping standards.
        • Report hazards and maintenance issues promptly.
        • Follow all site procedures, permits, and safety rules when carrying out work.

          • Administration and Communication

          • Log tasks, issues, and completed work accurately in facilities systems or trackers.
          • Communicate clearly with colleagues, contractors, and the wider business regarding facilities issues.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Practical, hands-on experience in a facilities, maintenance, building services, or similar role would be beneficial. Would also consider a practical DIY-minded candidate who is keen to learn and develop in a facilities environment.
  • Good basic understanding of building systems and site services, including lighting, furniture, basic plumbing, electrical awareness, and general building upkeep.
  • Comfortable using basic IT tools such as email, work order systems, Excel, and Word.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
  • Able to work independently and manage multiple small tasks across a busy site.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience working in an office, laboratory, or technical environment.
  • Familiarity with contractors and planned and reactive maintenance environments.
  • Basic health and safety awareness or related training.

Working Pattern:
  • This is primarily an office-hours role with standard working hours of 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Some flexibility will be required during planned shutdowns, office moves, or other scheduled out-of-hours activities.
  • The role is based in our Edinburgh office. Occasional travel to other UK locations, including Newbury and London, may be required to provide facilities support.
  • Very occasional participation in an out-of-hours emergency call-out rota will be required.
This position is based in our Edinburgh office, UK
 
You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.
 

Export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit candidates who are nationals of certain embargoed countries from working in this position without Cirrus Logic first obtaining an export license.  Candidates for this role must be able to access technical data without a requirement for an export license. We are unable to sponsor or obtain export licenses for this role.

GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

What You'll Do
Within 1 month, you will:
  • Know the team, the stack, and the cross-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
  • Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
  • Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.

    • Within 3 months, you will:
  • Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
  • Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
  • Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
  • Have a 12-18 month roadmap, setting the high-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio

    • Within 12 months, you will:
  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
  • Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

    • The Skill Set
  • 5+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate. 
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
  • Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead-to-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
  • Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
  • You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
  • You drive  strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
  • Run vendor evaluations end to end
  • Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).

title: Masseur / Physiotherapeuth (m/w/d) - Deimann Spa
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Hotel Deimann
description_html:
Wenn ein Gast nach einer Behandlung tiefenentspannt den Deimann Spa verlässt, ist genau das der Moment, in dem Ihre Arbeit spürbar wird. Mit fachlichem Können, Ruhe und einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste machen Sie aus einer Massage oder Wellnessanwendung eine wertvolle Auszeit.

Im Deimann Spa, dem Wellnessbereich unseres 5-Sterne-Superior-Hotels im Sauerland, verbinden wir professionelle Anwendungen mit herzlicher persönlicher Betreuung. Sie arbeiten in einem hochwertigen Umfeld, in dem Qualität nicht nur bei der Behandlung zählt, sondern auch in jedem Kontakt mit unseren Gästen.

Aufgaben

  • Führen Sie klassische und wellnessorientierte Massageanwendungen professionell und mit einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste durch.
  • Setzen Sie Ihr fachliches Wissen bei physiotherapeutischen Anwendungen ein, sofern diese Ihrer Qualifikation entsprechen, und begleiten Sie unsere Gäste verantwortungsvoll auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Wohlbefinden.
  • Beraten Sie unsere Gäste individuell zu passenden Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen und finden Sie gemeinsam mit ihnen die Behandlung, die zu ihren persönlichen Bedürfnissen passt.
  • Erkennen Sie im Rahmen Ihrer fachlichen Qualifikation die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste und stimmen Sie Ihre Behandlung entsprechend darauf ab.
  • Betreuen Sie unsere Gäste während ihres gesamten Aufenthalts im Deimann Spa aufmerksam, herzlich und professionell.
  • Bereiten Sie die Behandlungsräume sorgfältig vor und nach, damit jede Anwendung in einer ruhigen, gepflegten und hochwertigen Atmosphäre stattfinden kann.
  • Sichern Sie durch Ihre sorgfältige Arbeitsweise die hohen Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards unseres Spa-Bereichs.
  • Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihrem Spa-Team zusammen und tragen Sie dazu bei, dass unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und persönlich aufmerksam betreut werden.
  • Gestalten Sie mit Ihrer Arbeit ein Spa-Erlebnis, das unseren Gästen Ruhe, Entspannung und die besondere Qualität des Hotel Deimann vermittelt.
  • Arbeiten Sie überwiegend tagsüber bis in die Abendstunden, regulär bis etwa 19:00 Uhr. Auch Sonn- und Feiertage gehören zu Ihrem Arbeitsalltag.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Masseur/in, Physiotherapeut/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, damit Sie unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und verantwortungsvoll behandeln können.
  • Sie bringen idealerweise praktische Erfahrung in Massage, Physiotherapie, Wellness oder einem Spa mit – aber auch als Berufseinsteiger/in sind Sie willkommen, wenn Ihre fachliche Qualifikation und Ihre Haltung zu uns passen.
  • Sie verfügen über fachliche Kompetenz und arbeiten sorgfältig, weil hochwertige Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Präzision erfordern.
  • Sie haben Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Menschen, weil eine gute Spa-Behandlung nicht nur von der richtigen Technik, sondern ebenso von Aufmerksamkeit und Einfühlungsvermögen lebt.
  • Sie arbeiten serviceorientiert und aufmerksam, damit sich unsere Gäste während ihrer gesamten Behandlung persönlich wahrgenommen und bestens aufgehoben fühlen.
  • Sie treten gepflegt und professionell auf, weil Ihr persönliches Auftreten wesentlich zur hochwertigen Atmosphäre im Deimann Spa beiträgt.
  • Sie arbeiten selbstständig, zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst, damit sich unsere Gäste jederzeit auf Ihre fachliche und persönliche Betreuung verlassen können.
  • Sie sind ein Teamplayer und unterstützen Ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen, weil ein außergewöhnliches Spa-Erlebnis nur gemeinsam entstehen kann.
  • Sie bringen Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Sonn- und Feiertagen mit, da unser Spa auch an diesen Tagen für unsere Gäste geöffnet ist.
  • Sie verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse, damit Sie unsere Gäste sicher, aufmerksam und persönlich beraten und betreuen können.

Benefits

🕒 Work-Life-Balance

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Arbeitszeitkonto
  • Digitale Dienstplanung und faire Schichtverteilung

💶 Faire Bezahlung

  • Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt + steuerfreie Zuschläge
  • Kostenfreie Verpflegung – auch an freien Tagen
  • Wohnmöglichkeit im Hotel während der Probezeit

💼 Weiterentwicklung

  • Interne & externe Schulungen
  • Persönliche Förderung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

🎉 Teamkultur & Events

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents (z. B. Sommerfest)
  • Familiäres Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien

💳 Mitarbeiterrabatte

  • Bis zu 30 % Rabatt in unseren Betrieben
  • Vergünstigte Übernachtungen für Familie & Freunde
  • Corporate Benefits & internationale Kooperationen

Neugierig geworden? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – direkt online, unkompliziert und gerne auch ohne großes Anschreiben.

title: EDI  Developer/ Technical Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kryptos Technologies limited
description_html:
Tasks

EDI Developer/Technical lead

Location: Stuttgart, Germany ( Remote) Occasional travel to client sites at Stuttgart.

Duration: 12months+ Contract with Possible extension

Experience: 5-10 Years

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced EDI Axway TSIM Developer/Consultant with strong expertise in EDI/B2B integrations, EDI platform operations, mapping development, partner onboarding, and production support. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implement, ting, monitoring, and supporting EDI integrations across customers, suppliers, and ERP systems.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements and implement EDI integration solutions using Axway TSIM.
  • Develop, support, and optimize EDI mappings and interfaces.
  • Monitor EDI message flows and resolve production issues.
  • Configure and support trading partner onboarding and communication setups.
  • Perform incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
  • Prepare technical specifications, mapping documents, and solution designs.
  • Conduct testing, partner certification, go-live, and production support activities.
  • Participating in or leading EDI and integration projects.
  • Collaborate with business teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners throughout project delivery.

Requirements

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in EDI/B2B integration and support.
  • Hands-on experience with Axway TSIM and SAP PO, SAP Integration Suite / SAP CI
  • Strong knowledge of EDIFACT, ANSI X12, VDA, and Odette standards.
  • Experience with automotive messages such as DELFOR, DELJIT, DESADV, INVOIC, and ORDERS.
  • Experience with EDI mapping technologies and structured data formats (XML, XSLT, IDOC, JSON, CSV).
  • Knowledge of communication protocols: AS2, OFTP2, SFTP, HTTPS, SOAP, and REST APIs.
  • Good Understanding of SAP business processes (MM, SD, Logistics, Finance) and ERP integrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting, monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.
  • German: business fluent / negotiation level

Must -Have

  • Experience with SAP PO/PI and SAP Integration Suite (CPI/CI).
  • Knowledge of API-led and hybrid integration architectures.
  • Automotive industry experience and knowledge of supplier integrations.
  • Experience in international IT projects.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

title: (Junior) CRM Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at yfood Labs GmbH
description_html:
DEINE MISSION

Lust, Ernährung neu zu denken? Bei yfood machen wir seit 2017 gutes Essen alltagstauglich – ausgewogen, praktisch und richtig lecker. Mit unseren Produkten haben wir eine eigene Kategorie geformt: Smart Food. In ganz Europa unterwegs, rasant wachsend und immer auf der Suche nach neuen Ideen. Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein möchtest, das die Lebensmittelbranche revolutioniert, dann bist du bei yfood genau richtig.

Deine Aufgaben als CRM Manager

Zur Verstärkung unseres CRM-Teams suchen wir im Rahmen einer Elternzeitvertretung zunächst für 2 Jahre einen (Junior) CRM Manager, der unsere Kundenkommunikation über alle Märkte hinweg operativ mitgestaltet. Der Fokus liegt auf der Umsetzung unserer CRM-Kampagnen sowie der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Retention- und Loyalty-Maßnahmen.

  • Konzeption, Erstellung und Aussteuerung von CRM-Kampagnen mit Schwerpunkt E-Mail-Marketing in unserem CRM-Tool Emarsys
  • Entwicklung von zielgruppengerechtem und überzeugendem Copy für Newsletter, E-Mail-Flows und Kampagnen rund um Food & Nutrition
  • Analyse und Reporting der Kampagnenperformance anhand relevanter KPIs wie Öffnungs-, Klick- und Conversion-Raten sowie Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen
  • Durchführung und Auswertung von A/B-Tests zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Copy, Betreffzeilen und Customer Journeys
  • Einsatz von AI-Tools zur Optimierung und effizienteren Gestaltung bestehender Prozesse
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Grafik, Content und dem Webshop-Team
  • Erstellung SEO-optimierter Texte, beispielsweise für Landingpages, unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Keywords

DAS MACHT DICH AUS

Deine Qualifikationen als CRM Manager

  • Ca. 1–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung sowie erste Kenntnisse im Online-Marketing, insbesondere im E-Mail-Marketing
  • Grundkenntnisse im Bereich SEO
  • Ausgeprägte Copywriting-Skills und ein gutes Gespür für zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation, idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Bereich Food & Nutrition oder vergleichbaren Konsumgüter- bzw. Lifestyle-Themen
  • Erste Erfahrung mit einem CRM-Tool wie Emarsys, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud oder Braze – Emarsys-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss
  • Gutes analytisches Verständnis und sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kampagnen-KPIs
  • Hands-on-Mentalität sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise – auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten
  • Kreativität und ein gutes Gespür für Marke und Tonalität
  • Offene, kommunikative Art und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
  • Eigeninitiative und Lust darauf, Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben
  • Fließende Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1) Kenntnisse

WAS UNS ANTREIBT

Wir sind ein bisschen anders – und genau das macht uns aus

  • Leidenschaft – Wir brennen für das, was wir tun. Voller Energie, voller Optimismus, immer hungrig nach Neuem.
  • Verantwortung – Heißt für uns: Füreinander einstehen, Verantwortung übernehmen und alles geben, wenn’s drauf ankommt.
  • Professionalität – Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst – uns selbst aber nicht zu sehr. Wir sind offen, direkt und immer auf Augenhöhe. Kein Bullshit, kein Ego. Nur Team.
  • Innovation – Wir denken lieber „Warum eigentlich nicht?“ statt „Das war schon immer so.“ Wir lieben neue Ideen, unkonventionelle Wege – und bleiben nie stehen.

(WH)yfood?

Was wir dir bieten: Unsere Benefits

  • Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
  • yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
  • Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.
  • Urlaub ist wichtig. Daher erhältst du bei uns 30 Tage bezahlten Urlaub im Jahr.
  • yfood hält dich fit. Mit einer subventionierten Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM-Wellpass kannst du dir für nur 29€ im Monat Gutes tun. Dazu bieten wir im Rahmen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements & Healthy@yfood Workshops und Aktionen (z.B. Yoga, Breathwork, Soccer, Pickleball) an.
  • Gemeinsam Gutes tun. Mit unserem yforgood Day erhältst du einen bezahlten Tag pro Jahr, um gemeinsam mit deinem Team eine soziale, gemeinnützige oder ökologische Initiative zu unterstützen.
  • Weg vom Fleck. Wir steuern 30€ zu deinem ÖPNV-Ticket bei und bieten dir über JobRad die Möglichkeit, vergünstigt ein Fahrrad zu leasen.
  • Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven. Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
  • Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen. Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
  • Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

KONTAKT

Katharina Bauer
Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

Chancengleichheit für alle
yfood steht für die Chancengleichheit aller ein. Wir begrüßen und feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen. Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen.
Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung ausdrücklich.

title: Applied AI Scientist - LLMs & Voice
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wave
description_html:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year on year. And, we're still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people's everyday lives.

We're helping millions of customers across West Africa access financial services through mobile money, and great support is fundamental to that. We believe the future of customer support lies in machines handling boring repetitive tasks so humans can focus on high value interactions that require empathy and creativity

As an Applied AI Scientist on our Support Automation product team, you will:

  • Be responsible for driving the quality of our automated support through evaluating and improving everything the team builds
  • Bridge research and production, building agent systems that ship into real products.
  • Contribute to autonomous voice and digital agents that power 10M+ customer interactions per month across West Africa. 
  • Build for the hardest edge cases: poor connectivity, low literacy, and languages with little training data.
  • Experiment with, evaluate, and integrate the latest voice and text models.
  • Own problems end-to-end, from problem discovery to running in production, working alongside product and engineering leaders who prioritize shipping real customer impact.

If you're energized by ownership, thrive on deep technical challenges, and want to build infrastructure that serves millions in emerging markets, let's talk.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (US, UK, Spain, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso.
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once a year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $167,00 - $227,900 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in AI/ML experience
  • Proven hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI systems (evaluation, RAG, embeddings, safety and guardrails etc.).
  • Strong foundations in statistics and ML theory.
  • Solid Python skills.
  • Track record taking AI/ML systems from prototype to production and care deeply about reliability, performance, and scalability.
  • Fluency with AI agents, with bonus points for deploying them as part of production systems
  • Bonus points:
    • Research background in speech or LLMs
    • Proven Voice AI experience (ASR, TTS, latency optimization, real-time streaming, voice agents)
    • Experience building customer support or conversational AI systems
    • You follow the latest research in speech and LLMs, and know how to translate papers into production wins
    • Familiarity with low-resource language challenges
    • Building in high-risk agent environments like finance
    • Fluent in English, (bilingual in French is a big bonus!)

You might be a good fit if you

    • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and designing AI systems end-to-end without detailed specs
    • Obsess over evaluation – you've built frameworks to catch hallucinations, measure groundedness, and know when to trust your system
    • Balance research intuition with pragmatic engineering; you ship working systems, not just prototypes.
    • Like working with large datasets, complex pipelines, and modern ML infra (distributed training, feature stores, monitoring, etc.)

About engineering at Wave

We care about the big picture. We don't hire engineers to just ship tickets. We hire them to solve problems. That means caring deeply about outcomes, understanding context, and jumping in wherever something's broken, even if it's technically "not your area." When we see problems, inefficiencies, or opportunities to make something better, we act. We dig into operational issues, clarify fuzzy product specs, or step into unfamiliar code to help unblock teammates.

We move as fast as possible. Speed matters. It lets us try things quickly, get feedback early, and course-correct while it's cheap. So we write small PRs. We aim for MVPs. We leave TODOs and file follow-ups. We don't over-perfect v1. That said, we're building a financial product. Some things—like money movement, correctness, or security—deserve more caution.

We like boring technology. We favor tools that are reliable, well-understood, and easy to debug. This keeps us focused on solving meaningful problems instead of wrestling with unpredictable infrastructure. If a new technology helps us move faster, build safer, or solve a real need, we'll consider it. But we don't adopt tools just because they're new—we adopt them because they're right.

Simplicity is a strategy. It lets us focus our energy where it matters most: serving our users.

Recommended (optional):

We're currently receiving a high volume of submissions. To help us review genuine candidates faster, please send a JSON payload with your resume and/or any links as plain text via POST to this secure endpoint: https://api.wave.com/submit_resume

To authorize to this endpoint, you can use the following bearer token:  wave_ + (country code for any of our operating countries) + _ + [any characters of your choice].

You are encouraged to use a coding agent to generate the JSON and the request. This is intentionally quick - don't overthink it.

This task is optional and not required to apply. Please still submit your application through the normal form. We'll store the JSON payload for up to 30 days for review, then it will be deleted.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

About the Company

 

Firetecnics is one of London's most trusted LPCB-certified fire safety company, with one of the best reputations within the industry for over 35 years. For over 35 years, we've been the trusted fire safety partner to residential and commercial property professionals, delivering fast, reliable solutions that ensure full compliance and complete peace of mind. As a one-stop provider for everything from fire alarm installation to ongoing compliance management, we combine technical expertise with proactive, personalised service.

 

About the Role

 

We are looking for an experience Fire Alarm Service and Maintenance Engineer to join us on a permanent basis to support with scheduled upgrades, installs and repairs on fire alarm systems for our prestigious clients in and around the London area.

The ideal person will have a flexible approach to work, who can, on occasion, participate in an out of hours call out rota. 

A full UK Driving License is required along with previous Fire Alarm Experience and knowledge of analogue addressable and conventional fire alarm systems. 

 

Responsibilities

  • Pursue 'Great, not Good' in fire safety services
  • Be accountable for the quality system as well as providing excellent customer service
  • Service, maintain and install fire alarm systems (BS5839-1) in accordance with the relevant British Standards
  • Accurately complete engineer service reports
  • Report deficiencies or deviations in fire systems
  • Conduct regular van stock checks and liaise with the procurement department to keep replenished and appropriately stocked
  • Have a Health & Safety mindset, looking at possible risks associated with the role and reporting any issues promptly
  • Complete a first fix where possible

 

Qualifications

FIA training (or equivalent required) to BS5839-1 Fundamentals.

 

 

Required Skills

 

  • A full UK Driving License
  • Previous Fire Alarm Experience
  • Knowledge of analogue addressable and conventional fire alarm systems
  • Understanding of BS5839
  • Good level of IT literacy
  • Good communication skills both verbal and written
  • Understanding of Health and Safety Regulations
  • Commitment to high professional ethical standards
  • Collaborative working skills

 

 

Preferred Skills

 

  • Fire service experience

 

 

Pay range and compensation package

 

The role is full-time, and we are offering a competitive salary. This position will be based in the London Area with travel required to attend different sites. A full UK Driving License will be essential, and a company vehicle and fuel card will be provided.

 

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

 

We are committed to Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (ED&I) for everyone. All applicants will be treated fairly and without prejudice. No one will receive less favourable treatment or be discriminated irrespective of the following protected characteristics: Age, disability, gender reassignment (and identity), marriage and civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins), religion or belief, sex (formerly gender) and sexual orientation.

 

Next Steps

 

Send your CV to our specialist Talent Team by completing the form on this page and we will be in touch within seven days.

 

About Firetecnics Systems

Established in 1989, Firetecnics Systems Ltd is part of Helix International Group and is a leading UK fire safety, engineering and prevention company with an extensive service portfolio across consulting, designing, installing and maintaining a wide range of fire safety solutions, systems and equipment. This means we can provide one source for all your needs and the ability to integrate an entire fire safety solution. With two decades of experience, we understand buildings and the way they are occupied and used. We aim to deliver dedicated and unsurpassed service levels with a strong emphasis on adding value to your business. We reflect this in working with our clients to set service levels that are business led and by ensuring their values and requirements are paramount in everything we do.

title: Senior Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Funded.club
description_html:
Our customer is an AI-powered SMS and voice platform built for the performance marketing world. Their technology helps lead generation companies, affiliate networks, and call center operations dramatically improve contact rates and conversion — the metrics that actually move the needle for their buyers. They're a lean, globally distributed team of 10 operating out of Spain and Dubai, moving fast and building for scale.

This is a company in an exciting early phase — the product works, customers are seeing results, and now it's time to build the pipeline. If you want to be the person who shapes how a high-potential B2B SaaS company goes to market, this is a rare chance to do exactly that alongside a hands-on CEO who gives real autonomy.

About the position 

As the first dedicated Senior Account Executive, you will build the entire direct sales motion from the ground up. This is a hunter-first role in the early phase — you'll prospect, pitch, and close — but the real differentiator is what happens next. Every account you close is yours to onboard, expand, and grow. You'll be the full customer relationship, not just the closing signature.

What you'll own:

  • Build and own the full sales pipeline — prospecting, outreach, demos, negotiation, and close
  • Farm every account you close: onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Set up the sales tech stack — CRM, outreach sequences, playbooks — aligned with the CEO
  • Refine the ICP and pitch based on what's winning in the market
  • Maintain transparent pipeline and revenue forecasting for the leadership team
  • Feed customer insight back into the product roadmap through a structured feedback loop

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience selling to performance marketing agencies, lead gen companies, affiliate networks, or call centers
  • Proven track record as a hunter — opening doors, building pipeline, and closing deals
  • Comfortable with 2-month sales cycles and multi-stakeholder deals in the $5k–$30k MRR range
  • Genuine willingness to farm and grow accounts — not just close and move on
  • Deep understanding of performance marketing metrics: CPL, EPC, ROAS, and how buyers in this space measure ROI
  • Experience setting up or improving sales infrastructure — CRM, sequences, or playbooks
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and the pace of an early-stage environment
  • Active user of AI tools to accelerate prospecting, research, and outreach
  • Sharp, direct communicator — in writing and on calls
  • Fluent English; collaborative team player who works closely with leadership

Experience  

  • A background in B2B SaaS sales with direct exposure to the performance marketing or lead generation ecosystem — not just adjacent industries
  • 5+ years of total sales experience with visible progression, ideally including time as an early or first sales hire
  • Familiarity with affiliate networks, lead gen economics, and call center operations at a level that earns credibility quickly with buyers
  • Experience selling communications infrastructure (voice, SMS, CPaaS) is a strong plus — but deep ICP knowledge matters more
  • An existing network of contacts in the performance marketing space is a meaningful advantage
  • A builder mindset: you've created playbooks, set up CRMs, and run your own testing and iteration — not just executed someone else's motion

Compensation and Perks

  • Competitive base salary with commission on top for a competitive total package.
  • Contractor-first engagement with flexibility based on candidate preference
  • Fully remote — work from wherever you're most effective
  • Direct line to the CEO with genuine autonomy on day-to-day execution
  • Early-hire status — significant opportunity to shape the sales function and grow with the company
  • Collaborative, international team with leadership across Europe and the UAE

title: Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS)

company.name: The Copper River Family of Companies

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at The Copper River Family of Companies
description_html:
Coho Integrated Solutions is seeking a qualified Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS) to support the Department of the Air Force Family Advocacy Program in Lakenheath, Suffolk, United Kingdom. The FAIS serves as a clinical provider and prevention specialist responsible for supporting intervention and secondary prevention efforts related to domestic abuse, child maltreatment, problematic sexual behavior in children and youth, and family wellness.

The FAIS may augment the services of the Family Advocacy Treatment Manager and is expected to perform the applicable clinical and prevention responsibilities associated with the FATM role.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Provide clinical intervention, counseling, assessment, and case management services to individuals, couples, families, and groups.
  • Support assessment and treatment of domestic abuse and child maltreatment cases.
  • Conduct psychosocial, safety, risk, needs, and other clinical assessments as appropriate.
  • Develop and monitor individualized treatment and safety plans.
  • Provide psychotherapy, psychoeducation, crisis intervention, advocacy, and clinical casework.
  • Provide secondary prevention services addressing domestic abuse, child maltreatment, and problematic sexual behavior in children and youth.
  • Deliver New Leader Orientation and annual training to commanders, first sergeants, organizational leadership, and key agencies.
  • Serve as a prevention facilitator and installation FAP representative for the Community Action Team and other community organizations.
  • Develop, promote, and implement FAP prevention programs under the direction and approval of the FAP Manager.
  • Develop social marketing and outreach strategies to increase awareness of family maltreatment prevention resources.
  • Identify family violence trends and collaborate with FAP personnel and community organizations to target prevention efforts.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of prevention activities and support required program reporting.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Clearance:
    • Must be eligible for and maintain required privileging within the Military Treatment Facility
    • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust determination in accordance with applicable contract and government requirements
  • Education, Licensure, and Certifications:
    • Must be a U.S.-licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
      • LCSW: Master's degree from a CSWE-accredited school
      • LMFT: Master's degree from a COAMFTE-accredited Marriage and Family Therapy program, or an appropriately qualifying allied mental health degree with equivalent Marriage and Family Therapy study
    • Must maintain the applicable unrestricted professional license

title: Manager, Clinical Review and Quality Assurance
description_html:
Who We Are:

SmithRx is a rapidly growing, venture-backed Health-Tech company. Our mission is to disrupt the expensive and inefficient Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) sector by building a next-generation drug acquisition platform driven by cutting edge technology, innovative cost saving tools, and best-in-class customer service. With hundreds of thousands of members onboarded since 2016, SmithRx has a solution that is resonating with clients all across the country.

We pride ourselves for our mission-driven and collaborative culture that inspires our employees to do their best work. We believe that the U.S healthcare system is in need of transformation, and we come to work each day dedicated to making that change a reality. At our core, we are guided by our company values:

  • Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.
  • Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward—always.
  • Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:

SmithRx is looking for a dynamic and experienced leader to serve as the Manager, Clinical Review Operations and Quality Assurance. This pivotal role is responsible for the integrity, efficiency, and clinical strategy of our prior authorization (PA) ecosystem. You will lead a multidisciplinary function, integrating Quality Assurance (QA) oversight, technical system management, and medication policy execution. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring that our PA programs are safe, evidence-based, compliant, and operationally excellent.

What you will do:

  • Team Leadership: Mentor and unify a high-performing team across QA, medication policy, and business analysis to drive organizational goals.
  • Quality Assurance: Direct the PA quality assurance program, overseeing interrater reliability audits and reviewing team performance.
  • Platform Management: Lead PA platform strategy, technical enhancements, data governance, and clinical rule configuration for optimal efficiency.
  • Clinical Strategy: Provide pharmacotherapy expertise for P&T Committee activities, formulary management, and evidence-based medication policy development.
  • Process Improvement: Drive technology enhancements and monitor key performance metrics using data-driven insights.
  • Change Management: Facilitate process documentation, lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and manage stakeholder training for system releases.

What you will bring to SmithRx:

  • Education: Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) required.
  • Licensure: Active, unrestricted Registered Pharmacist (RPh) license.
  • Experience: 10+ years in clinical pharmacy, specifically within Health Plan or PBM environments.
  • Technical Proficiency: 5+ years supporting PA platforms, including ePA standards (NCPDP) and rule configuration (e.g., Banjo Health, MHK).
  • Domain Expertise: Strong background in QA best practices, clinical utilization review, P&T committee support, and regulatory compliance.
  • Analytical Skills: Proven ability to translate complex data and business requirements into actionable system changes.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication and influencing skills with a bias for action in fast-paced environments.

What SmithRx Offers You:

  • Highly competitive wellness benefits including Medical, Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Benefits
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Program
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Discretionary Paid Time Off
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Wellness Benefits
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Paid Parental Leave benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Well-stocked kitchen in office locations
  • Professional development and training opportunities

  • San Francisco Bay Area - California
  • Metro New York City - Connecticut, New Jersey, New York and Pennsylvania

$163,200—$192,000 USD

Zone B includes the following locations:

  • California - outside of San Francisco Bay Area
  • Metro Denver / Boulder - Colorado
  • Metro District of Columbia - District of Columbia, Maryland, Virginia and West Virginia

  • Non metro Colorado, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and West Virginia

Zone C Pay Range

$136,000—$160,000 USD

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: The range listed above reflects our standard pay scale and actual pay will vary based on work location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
  • Total Rewards: In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or equity. SmithRx offers a variety of benefits to help you live well, including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance and 401(k).

Individual offers are tailored to your geography, experience, skills, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details during the hiring process. In the meantime, feel free to explore our comprehensive benefits here.

title: Product Manager, Growth
description_html:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
  • Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

We’re looking for an evidence-based, customer-centric, and innovative Product Manager to join our growing product org. As a Growth PM, you will play a key role in our product-led growth and self-serve initiatives within our Product Growth team. This team is focused on identifying where the product can do more to help customers realize value and where that value can translate into durable business growth.

Your goal will be to understand the core value levers of our product and use strong growth instincts to drive activation, adoption, monetization, retention, and expansion. We believe the strongest product-led growth comes from helping customers realize value through thoughtful product experiences, not from forcing growth at the expense of customer trust.

Reporting to the Growth Group Product Manager, you will build growth loops, develop hypotheses, run experiments, and turn insight into product improvements that create value for both customers and the business. You will partner closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and other cross-functional teammates to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Who You Are

Our ideal candidate is curious, proactive, customer-centric, and energized by solving growth problems through product. You have strong product judgment, a bias toward learning, and a demonstrated ability to turn customer insight and data into measurable impact.

You have experience in product-led growth and self-serve product development, with a strong understanding of funnels, loops, lifecycle optimization, and experimentation. You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution, and you know how to use both quantitative and qualitative inputs to make sound product decisions.

You are self-sufficient with data, comfortable exploring dashboards and analyzing funnels, and able to use evidence to influence priorities. You are also fluent in modern AI tools and concepts, whether through building AI-powered features or using AI to improve the quality and speed of your work.

You are a strong cross-functional partner who collaborates effectively with engineering, design, research, data, marketing, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders. You care deeply about craft and customer experience, and you believe the best growth comes from helping users realize value faster and more often, not from adding friction or compromising product quality.

Your Impact

  • Drive product growth across key parts of the customer journey, including activation, adoption, monetization, retention, and expansion
  • Build and optimize growth loops that are repeatable, scalable, and measurable
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer behavior, funnel performance, lifecycle moments, and value realization to identify high-leverage opportunities
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with design, engineering, data, marketing, and customer-facing teams to develop effective strategies and deliver measurable outcomes
  • Use quantitative analysis, qualitative insight, and product judgment to inform priorities and decisions
  • Generate and test hypotheses through thoughtful experimentation and rapid iteration
  • Contribute to growth strategy and roadmap decisions by identifying opportunities, recommending priorities, and driving execution within your area
  • Guide initiatives through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and prioritization through launch, analysis, and optimization
  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, learnings, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leaders
  • Help raise the bar for experimentation rigor, evidence-based decision-making, and product quality across the team

Your Experience

  • 3-5 years in product management, including meaningful experience in product-led growth and/or experimentation-focused roles in modern B2B SaaS environments
  • BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, Business, Design, or related equivalent field/experience
  • Strong quantitative business acumen and comfort using data to identify opportunities, evaluate performance, and inform decisions
  • In-depth knowledge of product growth best practices, experimentation, and funnel analysis
  • Passion for customer and business success, shortening time to value, and the craft of product management
  • Strong ability to understand users and rally teams around the right problems to solve
  • Proven track record of strong cross-functional collaboration
  • An entrepreneurial spirit – you are self-driven, accountable, and comfortable presenting to customers, prospects, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Egoless self-starter with great product sense, curiosity, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a growth mindset.
  • Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, from shaping direction to driving execution and iteration
  • Demonstrated fluency with modern AI tools and concepts, either through building AI-powered product experiences or using AI meaningfully to improve product thinking, execution, analysis, and decision-making
  • Champion our core values of intelligence, intensity, integrity, and ownership

Considered a plus

  • Experience in fleet, automotive, transportation software, vertical SaaS, or a related space
  • Experience writing and reading SQL
  • Experience across multiple growth surfaces, such as onboarding, trial, adoption, monetization, or lifecycle experiences
  • Experience with hybrid B2B PLG and SLG products
  • Experience optimizing mature products as well as exploring zero-to-one opportunities
  • Experience building, launching, or iterating on AI-powered product features or workflows
  • Experience working in design-forward, product-led environments with a strong emphasis on user experience, craft, and thoughtful growth

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

Soft Skills

title: GTM - AI
description_html:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

You have one goal: grow AI on Kalshi. Founder energy, whatever it takes, fast. Be smart, be creative, think outside the box, tap into the community. Above all, help build a great product.

You own AI holistically: markets, liquidity, growth, paid, all of it.

What You'll Do

  • Market Coverage: Get every AI market that should exist onto Kalshi. Model release predictions, benchmark milestones, lab news, AGI timeline bets, whatever the community is already arguing about, we should have a market on it.

  • Growth, organic: This is your main job. Get in front of AI Twitter, r/singularity, r/LocalLLaMA, the model-release-day crowd, the newsletter writers.

  • Growth, paid: Ideate on and help build static and video assets to run on paid social (IG, TikTok, X, Reddit).

  • Growth, affiliates: Recruit the AI YouTubers, X accounts, and newsletter writers people who care about AI already trust.

Who You Are

  • Deeply obsessed with AI

  • Relentless

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.
